about: Request eval: a unit asking for recon by radio, read from its words in code, no model (docs/tracks.md, Recon requests and tasking). Each case is what a unit said after its call sign, and what splitRequest in lib/geo/requests.ts should make of it: request (true or false), words (the request as said), text (what is left for the model), n (the track it is about) and only (true when the call was only the request). Fields left out are not scored. Run with npm run eval:requests; npm test runs it too. The cases tagged held_out were written by a separate agent from the rules alone, without the code, and scored before anyone looked at them: 20 of 20 on 21 Nov.
